title_fil: Ang mga Tungkulin ng Isang BHW
objectives_fil: Maipapaliwanag ng BHW kung bakit mas malawak ang kanyang tungkulin sa ilalim ng UHC Act kaysa sa paghahatid lamang ng serbisyong pangkalusugan.
Mailalarawan ng BHW ang tatlong tungkuling bumubuo sa kanyang papel bilang Health Education and Promotion Officer: Health Educator, Community Organizer, at Health Service Provider.
Matutukoy ng BHW kung aling tungkulin ang kanyang ginagampanan sa isang partikular na sitwasyon sa barangay, at makapagbibigay siya ng halimbawa nito mula sa sariling karanasan.
Maililista ng BHW ang mga talaan at dokumentong responsibilidad niya bilang health service provider, at kung saan napupunta ang bawat isa.
objectives_en: The BHW can explain why their role under the UHC Act is wider than delivering health services alone.
The BHW can describe the three roles that make up their work as a Health Education and Promotion Officer: Health Educator, Community Organizer, and Health Service Provider.
The BHW can identify which role they are performing in a given barangay situation, and give an example of it from their own experience.
The BHW can list the records and documents they are responsible for as a health service provider, and where each one goes.
summary_fil: Isang umaga lang ni BHW Marites, tatlong magkaibang tungkulin na ang nagampanan niya — at iisa lang ang pinagmumulan ng tatlo. Sa ilalim ng UHC Act, ang BHW ay hindi na lamang tagahatid ng serbisyo: siya ay Health Education and Promotion Officer ng barangay, at sa ilalim ng payong na iyon nakaupo ang tatlong tungkuling galing sa RA 7883 — ang Health Educator na naghahanda sa tao bago pa dumating ang sakit, ang Community Organizer na nagbubuklod sa komunidad at sa health staff para may kumilos nang sabay-sabay, at ang Health Service Provider na siyang unang nasasalubong ng pangangailangan at siya ring humahawak ng talaan nito. Ang talaang iyon ang nagpapatuloy sa kuwento: ang household profile at master list na sinusulat ngayon ay siyang magsasabi bukas kung saan dapat pumunta ang programa. Kaya ang tanong sa bawat sitwasyon ay hindi "trabaho ko ba ito?" kundi "alin sa tatlo kong tungkulin ang kailangan dito ngayon?"
summary_en: In a single morning, BHW Marites performed three different roles — and all three come from the same place. Under the UHC Act a BHW is no longer only a deliverer of services: they are the barangay's Health Education and Promotion Officer, and under that umbrella sit the three roles RA 7883 names — the Health Educator who prepares people before illness arrives, the Community Organizer who binds the community and the health staff together so people can act as one, and the Health Service Provider who meets the need first and keeps the record of it. That record is what carries the story forward: the household profile and master list written today are what tell the programme tomorrow where it should go. So the question in any situation is not "is this my job?" but "which of my three roles does this need right now?"
